comparison.objective: Push a coolant hose fully onto a barb and tighten its clamp with a nut driver.
comparison.physical_skill: Coaxial insertion against drag, socket seating, repeated wrist turns and regrasping.
comparison.success_condition: Hose within 3 mm of the shoulder, clamp correctly located and tightened to 3 N·m, tool and hands clear for 1 s.
comparison.reason: This is the closest tool-alignment record, but its tested outcome is insertion and rotary tightening; it has no impact, sacrificial fracture, retained-coil protection, or fragment recovery.
